name: Wand over Fist
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Hey, adventurer. Sorry to be so short with ye earlier... and no, that ain't a pun.

I figured out where Trelane's first item ended up: Kor'gresh has it in Boulderfist Hall. An' by the way he was throwing down blasts of ice at his kin to keep them in line, he must be close to figurin' out how to use all of its powers.

Boulderfist Hall's south of here an' then east of Thandol Span. Find the ogre an' get back that wand.

While you're gone, I'll figure out what we're gonna do about Stromgarde.
narrative.objectives: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Brilliant, adventurer. One item down an' three more to go, based on my list. The other three items are all in Stromgarde.

Take a rest an' get your strength back--the next phase of my plan'll require a little more time an' effort. Come back to me after you've gotten a warm meal an' some rest.
narrative.requestItemsText: Our goal is the wand, adventurer. Focus on that for now.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 32 to 39, 18,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.objectiveText: Find Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Worth Its Weight in Gold
quests.objectiveText: Find 10 Witherbark Tusks, 4 Witherbark Medicine Pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife for Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Wand over Fist
quests.objectiveText: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Trelane's Defenses
quests.objectiveText: Find an Azure Agate and bring it to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Attack on the Tower
quests.objectiveText: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
